**Finding: missing — TRANSITION (medium severity)**

**What I checked**
- Section 4 (`sec-1.4`, paras p0023–p0029): the termination machinery covers only the notice period, the "Termination Date" definition, and the Termination Payment the *Company* owes HDI. Nothing on exit.
- Section 1 (HDI's responsibilities): HDI hosts the Site on its own server (1.3), holds our Content (2.1), and generates order/inventory export files (1.5) — so our data plainly sits in HDI's environment.
- Section 8 (Confidentiality): imposes use/disclosure restrictions on HDI but no return or deletion obligation.
- Section 10.7 (Survival): survives only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10 — no exit obligations preserved.
- Searches for data return/export and related terms returned nothing; no precedent language was available in memory.

**Conclusion**
There is no transition-assistance or data-return clause anywhere in the Agreement. That fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance plus export within 30 days) and sits close to walk-away territory, since HDI could simply switch off the Site with our customer and order data on its systems.

**Redline (validated ok:true, inserted as new Section 4.3 after p0029)** — at the preferred position:
- (a) up to six (6) months' reasonable transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, including Site migration to us or our designee;
- (b) return of all Content, customer/user information and order data within thirty (30) days in a commonly used machine-readable format, plus Site and URL access credentials;
- (c) deletion thereafter, certified in writing.

The comment offers a 90-day assistance period as the fallback if HDI resists the six-month tail.
